witness.branch: Conjunctive trail prerequisites, subject to all Subsection (B) exceptions
witness.quote: Has been dedicated to the City for use as such a trail;
witness.reason: A barrier can leave a connected route supporting motorized operation within the qualifying trail.
required_context: Document official trail designation, City dedication, posted prohibition and evidence relevant to sign appropriateness.
Establish barrier geometry, route connectivity, vehicle clearance, trail boundaries and actual operation within them.
Establish barrier placement, route connectivity and vehicle clearance without assuming complete blockage.
Establish motorized device characteristics and operator control without treating the distinct supplied definition of motor vehicle as an established municipal definition.
Establish the motorized vehicle's route within the trail corridor and its operator.
Retain emergency status, actual maintenance use and mobility-device design and use.
Retain emergency-vehicle status, actual maintenance use, and mobility-device design and use separately; preserve unresolved definition applicability and judgment meanings.
Retain independent documentary evidence of official nonmotorized-trail designation and dedication to the City, plus posted prohibition signs and evidence bearing on their appropriateness.
witness.subject_reason: The retained motor-vehicle driver can be the person operating the motorized vehicle.
